current_qty.first:
=ARRAYFORMULA(
  IF(A2:A = "", "",
    IFERROR(VLOOKUP(A2:A, QUERY({top_light_sales_products!E2:E, top_light_sales_products!G2:G, top_light_sales_products!D2:D}, "SELECT Col1, SUM(Col2) WHERE Col1 IS NOT NULL AND Col3 = 3 GROUP BY Col1 LABEL SUM(Col2) ''"), 2, FALSE), 0)
    -
    IFERROR(VLOOKUP(A2:A, QUERY({top_light_sales_returns!F2:F, top_light_sales_returns!G2:G, top_light_sales_returns!D2:D}, "SELECT Col1, SUM(Col2) WHERE Col1 IS NOT NULL AND Col3 = 3 GROUP BY Col1 LABEL SUM(Col2) ''"), 2, FALSE), 0)
    -
    IFERROR(VLOOKUP(A2:A, QUERY({top_light_islamic_sales_products!E2:E, top_light_islamic_sales_products!G2:G, top_light_islamic_sales_products!D2:D}, "SELECT Col1, SUM(Col2) WHERE Col1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Col1 LABEL SUM(Col2) ''"), 2, FALSE), 0)
    +
    IFERROR(VLOOKUP(A2:A, QUERY({top_light_islamic_sales_returns!F2:F, top_light_islamic_sales_returns!G2:G, top_light_islamic_sales_returns!D2:D}, "SELECT Col1, SUM(Col2) WHERE Col1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Col1 LABEL SUM(Col2) ''"), 2, FALSE), 0)
  )
)
